responsibility: This module implements libgccjit, GCC's embeddable just-in-time compilation subsystem and its integration into the normal GCC pipeline. Its core responsibility is to expose a stable public C API and thin C++ bindings for clients to construct code in memory, record that API-driven IR in an internal recording layer, dump or emit source-replay forms of the recorded graph, replay and lower it into GCC trees through a dummy frontend and playback layer, run it through the middle end and backend, and return a loaded result object for symbol lookup or emit output files. Around that core, the module also handles builtin-function mapping, diagnostic forwarding, internal logging, temporary-directory and host-specific runtime support such as Windows helpers, minimal driver/build/config hooks, and user-facing manuals and tutorial examples that document how to drive GCC as a JIT rather than as a traditional source-language frontend.
